title: EndringsskjemaDataPrefill
description: Prefill payload for endringsskjema (changes, assignment, lien, license). Send as multipart data element with type 'endringsskjemaData-prefill' when creating an instance via API. Submitter/requestor and agent details are never part of the payload - they are derived from the authenticated Altinn user.

domain.description: IP domain the change applies to. Required. Determines which requestType values are valid.

requestType.description: Type of change. Required. Allowed values depend on domain - see conditional validation below. Note: 'pph' exists in the form but is not supported via API prefill.

contactEmail.description: Contact email for the submission. Required.

inquiryMessage.description: Free-text message. Used as the main message for requestType 'other', and as 'other information' for 'nameAddress'.

ipCases.description: IP case/application numbers the change applies to. At least one is required. For requestType 'goodsAndServices' only the first entry is used.

items.description: Application number. Patent/design: year + 4 digits (e.g. '20250021'). Trademark: year + 5 digits (e.g. '202200912').

nameAddress.description: Name/address change details. Used when requestType is 'nameAddress'.

changeNameAddress.description: Existing applicants/owners the change applies to, comma-separated. Each name must match a proprietor/applicant registered on the IP case - either the full registry label or just the name part. Values that match nothing are dropped.

newNameAddress.description: The updated participant. All participants listed in changeNameAddress are changed to this.

otherInformation.description: Other information. Mapped to the form's free-text message field.

fusion.description: Assignment/merger/division details. Used when requestType is 'fusion'.

agentChange.description: Change of representative. Used when requestType is 'agentChange'.

agentChangeType.description: 'newFromRequestor' = the logged-in user becomes the new agent (details derived from Altinn). 'remove' = the current agent is removed and no new agent is registered.

license.description: License details. Required when requestType is 'license'.

role.description: Role of the logged-in submitter. Required. 'licensor' = submitter grants the license. 'licensee' = submitter is inserted as the first row of licensees, payload licensees follow after. 'agent' = agent details are derived from the logged-in user and representsInLicenseCase is required.

representsInLicenseCase.description: Which parties the agent represents. Required when role is 'agent', ignored otherwise.

regarding.description: What the notice concerns. 'agreement' = entering into a license agreement, 'agreement3Party' = agreement with a third party, 'transfer' = transfer of an existing license, 'compolsoryLicense' = compulsory license, 'terminateAgreement' = termination.

licenseType.description: Type of license. Both casings are accepted - the lower-camelCase form is normalized to the PascalCase form used internally.

extent.description: Whether the license covers the whole right or only parts of it.

partsOfTheRightInfo.description: Description of which parts of the right the license covers. Only relevant when extent is 'partsOfTheRight'.

date.description: Date the license agreement was entered into (ISO 8601, e.g. '2026-04-01').

licensor.description: The licensor(s), comma-separated. Must match a proprietor/applicant registered on the IP case - either the full registry label or just the name part. Values that match nothing are dropped.

licensees.description: The licensee(s). When role is 'licensee' the logged-in user is inserted as the first row and these follow after.

lien.description: Lien/pledge details. Required when requestType is 'lien'. Not available for domain 'design'.

role.description: Role of the logged-in submitter. Required. 'lienee' = submitter owns the pledged right, lienHolder must be supplied. 'lienholder' = submitter holds the lien and lienHolder is derived from the logged-in user (any supplied lienHolder is ignored). 'agent' = agent details are derived from the logged-in user, lienHolder must be supplied and representsInLienCase is required.

representsInLienCase.description: Which parties the agent represents. Required when role is 'agent', ignored otherwise.

lienHolder.description: The party holding the lien. Required when role is 'lienee' or 'agent'. Ignored when role is 'lienholder'.

lienees.description: The party/parties pledging the right, comma-separated. Must match a proprietor/applicant registered on the IP case - either the full registry label or just the name part. Values that match nothing are dropped.

rightType.description: The type of right being pledged. Allowed values depend on domain - see conditional validation below.

date.description: Date the lien agreement was entered into (ISO 8601, e.g. '2026-04-01').

totalSize.description: Total size of the secured claim in NOK, e.g. 'NOK 5 000 000'.

goodsAndServices.description: Limitation of goods/services. Used when requestType is 'goodsAndServices' (trademark only).

items.description: The classes to delete or change.

classNumber.description: Nice class number 1-45. Leading zeros are stripped, so '09' and '9' are equivalent. The class must exist on the referenced trademark case.

deleteOrChange.description: 'delete' removes the whole class, 'change' replaces its goods/services text with changedText.

changedText.description: The new goods/services text for the class. Required when deleteOrChange is 'change'.

deleteOrDraw.description: Withdrawal/deletion details. Used when requestType is 'deleteOrDraw'.

deleteOrDrawChangeType.description: 'draw' = withdraw a pending application, 'delete' = delete a granted/registered right.

participant.description: A person or organization. Supply either person fields (firstName + lastName) or organization fields (companyName and/or companyNumber), never both.

participantType.description: Type of participant. If omitted it is inferred from which fields are present.

companyName.description: Required for an organization unless companyNumber is supplied.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. 'NO'. Look up valid values via GET /pat/endringsskjema/api/options/countries?language=nb and use the returned 'value'.
